content:
Definitively stuck. The body cannot move off the Notice Board tile at (2,7) no matter what I try — raw movement in all directions (up to 10s holds), diagonal holds, the pathfinder to many targets, and E interactions in all facings. The pathfinder confirms the start tile itself is blocked by the Notice Board.

I cannot gather the 3 Wood and 2 Stone, nor reach the workbench, so crafting the Crown is impossible from this state.

I'm stuck: my body is embedded in the Notice Board at (2,7) and the engine won't move it off that blocked tile, so I can't gather materials or reach the workbench to craft the Crown.
